blocks.source: Vol IV, Deployment Release, § Maintaining Release Through Updates
blocks.md: Continuing the stipulated warehouse branch, suppose the mobile manipulator's restricted mug-delivery policy is retrained to reduce hesitation at the controlled pick station. Pushing that updated checkpoint directly to the fleet would invalidate the signed manifest and expose the machine to unverified bus loads and contact trajectories. Before the candidate neural policy can issue commands to physical actuators, it must pass back through the release decision.

questions.q: The section **Maintaining Release Through Updates** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: When every child claim is required the case is conjunctive and its confidence falls below every premise, so an assessor looks for the least-supported premise, and only genuinely independent sufficient legs add confidence.

The release manifest binds every upstream record, the argument digest, binary hashes, calibration, standing conditions, wear budget, expiry, and the adjudicator's signature to one configuration and gates motion fail-closed.

Before signing, an independent reviewer hunts defeaters with probes at the envelope extremes, domain transfer, structural independence, and unmonitored wear, and the review recurs against normalization of deviance.

An update reopens the claims whose evidence it touches, an unchanged enforcer binary does not imply an unchanged containment argument, and shadow mode filters candidates while contained canaries qualify them.
